comments.body: @mthuret Will do both, I have an idea for the story :+1:

Here is the story @mthuret 

![](http://g.recordit.co/yFop51qqbi.gif)

How do you organize your files into `stories` directory? Since I had to write more logic than expected, it feels a bit dirty to put everything into `stories/SearchBox.stories.js`
@Haroenv made a good point that I should simplify the story for people taking it as code example and also to use the react-storybook built-in "action logger" 👍
Yes, by using the `action` function of storybook, you'll simplify a lot the story :)
